features.name: any_comment_names_specific_program_or_location
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment reference a specific, named external program or location?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments (JSON list of other users' comments). Return 1 if at least one comment itself references a specific, named external program (e.g. a named government/social/educational program or initiative) or a specific named location (e.g. a named city, country, or place) as part of its argument; otherwise 0. Generic unnamed references ("some programs", "other countries") do not count. Empty list gives 0; missing or malformed input gives null. Ignore any OP view-change/delta-award announcements or reports of the outcome as evidence.

features.name: all_comments_only_abstract_logical_refutation
features.definition: Do the counter-argument comments rely only on abstract logical refutation, with no specific named external program or location?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments. Return 1 if there is at least one comment and every comment argues solely through abstract logical reasoning/refutation (e.g. pointing out logical flaws, premises, definitions, hypotheticals) without referencing any specific named external program or location; return 0 if any comment names a specific external program or location or relies on other non-abstract content such as concrete data/examples. Empty list gives null; missing or malformed input gives null. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements or reports of the outcome as evidence.

h0: Discussion view-change rates do not differ between rows with any_comment_names_specific_program_or_location and rows with all_comments_only_abstract_logical_refutation.
h1: Rows with any_comment_names_specific_program_or_location have higher view-change rates than rows with all_comments_only_abstract_logical_refutation.
note: The claim compares named-reference discussions (A) with abstract-only discussions (B). In the rhs, each coefficient is relative to a baseline of rows that are neither, so no single coefficient equals beta_A - beta_B; term=null. Neither-group rows (e.g. concrete but unnamed examples) and overlap are preserved. Operational assumptions: "specific named" means an explicit proper name; "abstract logical refutation" is judged from comment text only. Comments are current text and may include outcome announcements; the prompt excludes them. Associations only.
